scenario.zh: 为电动滑板车控制器设计散热方案，协调CAD变更与热仿真及安全标准
scenario.en: Design cooling for e-scooter controller, coordinating CAD changes with thermal simulation and safety standards

instruction.zh: 确定本次迭代的主要对齐维度
instruction.en: Identify primary alignment dimension for this iteration

output.zh: 简报重点：散热设计需同时满足温度限值和防护等级要求
output.en: Brief focus: cooling design must meet temperature limits and protection rating requirements

output.zh: 简报重点：材料变更需考虑采购成本和供应商交付能力
output.en: Brief focus: material change considers procurement cost and supplier delivery capability

instruction.zh: 选择用于验证设计变更的数据源
instruction.en: Select data source to validate design changes

output.zh: 简报显示：铜散热片峰值温度更低，热阻表现优于铝材方案
output.en: Brief shows: copper heatsink peak temperature lower, thermal resistance better than aluminum

output.zh: 简报显示：新结构通过振动测试，焊点可靠性符合车规标准
output.en: Brief shows: new structure passed vibration test, solder joint reliability meets automotive standards

instruction.zh: 检查两种设计对齐策略的差异
instruction.en: Review differences between two alignment strategies

output.zh: 简报方案：保持外形仅换材料，CAD改动较少，工装复用
output.en: Brief approach: keep geometry swap material only, fewer CAD changes, reuse tooling

output.zh: 简报方案：采用铜材并增加翅片密度，热性能更优但需重做工装
output.en: Brief approach: copper with higher fin density, better thermal performance but tooling redo needed

instruction.zh: 查看最终简报并选择后续操作
instruction.en: Review final brief and choose follow-up action

output.zh: 简报包含：CAD变更清单、仿真验证、合规检查和工程变更建议
output.en: Brief contains: CAD change list, simulation validation, compliance check, ECO recommendations

output.zh: 简报标注：铜材性能优异但成本较高，建议热设计和采购联合评审
output.en: Brief notes: copper performance excellent but cost higher, recommend joint thermal and procurement review

takeaway.zh: Flow Engineering通过AI代理自动对齐CAD、仿真和需求，让硬件迭代更快
takeaway.en: Flow Engineering auto-aligns CAD, simulation and requirements via AI agents for faster hardware iteration

initial.zh: 控制器散热片材料从铝改为铜，增加翅片表面积，确保符合UL2272温度标准
initial.en: Controller heatsink material from aluminum to copper, increased fin area, ensure UL2272 temp compliance
